query: How can I file a complaint about illegal mining operations in Tamil Nadu's forests?
reference_answer:
Reporting Illegal Mining:
To report illegal mining in forest areas of Tamil Nadu, contact the Tamil Nadu Forest Department's toll-free number (1800-425-3355) or visit the nearest forest range office. You can also report anonymously through the department's website or mobile app.
answer: To file a complaint about illegal mining in Tamil Nadu's forests, contact the Forest Department of Tamil Nadu directly. You can also reach out to local police stations or NGOs like the Forest Rights Act (FRA) for assistance. [Document 1]
